claims.author: maflcko
claims.harm: Call sites may easily forget to unwrap the inner result and miss interruption
claims.quote: Seems fragile to use `util::Result<InterruptResult>`. Wrapping one result into another is fragile, because call-sites may easily forget to unwrap the inner result

status_by.quote: It sounds like you want `Result<InterruptResult, void>` to be replaced with `Result<void, InterruptResult>` which would be ok with me.

claims.status_note: author replied that replacing with Result<void, InterruptResult> would be fine and safer, though not yet changed

claims.author: purpleKarrot
claims.harm: Result-style error handling undermines runtime performance and runs contrary to C++ idioms
claims.quote: I see Result-style error handling as a rustism that should be kept out of the C++ codebase of Bitcoin core.

claims.author: optout21
claims.harm: Ignoring the return value from FlushStateToDisk while allowing it to mutate validation state creates inconsistencies
claims.quote: the return value from `FlushStateToDisk` is ignored, but it can cause change in `state` -- unclear if this was intended or just an unintended side effect.

status_by.quote: Addressing this single case has been split off into #35621 .

claims.status_note: author clarified the comment in a push and reviewer accepted splitting the issue into #35621
